usedFor: Veeqo manages inventory, and Google Docs lists each “New Incomplete Purchase Order” through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Incomplete Purchase Order” in Veeqo, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Incomplete purchase orders gather in one doc tab, so a buyer can review them without logging in to Veeqo.

watchOut: “New Incomplete Purchase Order” is polling, so a doc entry appears after the next scheduled check.
